final_topology.title: Azure Hub-Spoke Network
final_topology.description: A hub-and-spoke Azure network with centralized security and management.
final_topology.topology_summary: The hub contains an Azure Firewall and Azure Bastion. Spokes are VNETs for identity, operations, and workloads, with all inter-spoke traffic routed through the hub firewall.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' (n16) that manages inventory for various nodes and zones, indicating a detailed asset inventory is maintained.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation System' (n17) that manages data flow documentation for various nodes and zones, indicating data flows are documented.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology shows multiple VNETs (Identity VNet, Operations VNet, Workload VNet, Non-Production VNet) that are segmented and routed through the hub firewall, indicating data processing and storage are segmented based on sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Azure Firewall' (n1) that manages traffic for various VNETs, indicating firewalls are implemented and managed on servers.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n7) that is configured and managed by the Azure Firewall (n1), indicating trusted DNS servers are configured on enterprise assets.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Server' (n8) that is configured and managed by the Azure Bastion (n2), indicating MFA is required for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filter' (n9) that is monitored by the Azure Firewall (n1), indicating DNS filtering services are used.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n10) that is monitored by the Azure Firewall (n1), indicating network-based URL filters are maintained and enforced.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology shows a hub-and-spoke network design with centralized security and management, indicating a secure network architecture is established and maintained.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes 'IaC Management' (n18) that manages various nodes and zones, indicating network infrastructure is securely managed using IaC.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'AAA Server' (n12) that is configured and managed by the Azure Bastion (n2), indicating centralized network AAA is implemented.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Azure Bastion' (n2) that manages remote access and is connected to the AAA Server (n12), indicating remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIDS' (n11) that is monitored by the Azure Firewall (n1), indicating a network intrusion detection solution is deployed.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology shows forced tunneling between the hub VNet and spoke VNets (Identity, Operations, Workload, Non-Production) through the Azure Firewall (n1), indicating traffic filtering between network segments is performed.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'NAC' (n14) that is configured and managed by the Azure Firewall (n1), indicating access control for remote assets is managed.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Log Analytics Workspace' (n3) that collects traffic logs from various VNets (Identity, Operations, Workload), indicating network traffic flow logs are collected.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production VNet' (z6) that is separated from other VNets, indicating production and non-production systems are separated.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Pen Testing Process' (n19) that manages various nodes and zones, indicating periodic external penetration tests are performed.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not explicitly show an asset inventory system or process. However, it includes various nodes and zones that could be part of an inventory.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset inventory system and links to all other nodes.

findings_before.title: Document Data Flows
findings_before.evidence: The topology shows various links and connections but does not explicitly document data flows.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit documentation of data flows.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a data flow documentation system and links to relevant nodes and zones.

findings_before.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various security components but does not explicitly show version-controlled IaC or secure network protocols.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of version-controlled IaC or secure network protocols.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing IaC and links to relevant nodes and zones.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an External Pen Test Zone, but it does not explicitly show a process for performing penetration tests.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of a process for performing penetration tests.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a penetration testing process and links to relevant nodes and zones.
